column1: # Authoritative permissible value ranges - versioned specification
# Version 2026-08-21, approved by the study lead. This file IS the binding
# range specification of the analysis pipeline; it consolidates the study's
# physician range documentation into canonical analysis units.
# Bounds are inclusive. For LABORATORY parameters (nonpositive_impossible=yes),
# a floor of 0 is the entry floor of the field, not a plausible measured value:
# documented values <= 0 are excluded as impossible on every analysis and
# quality path and reported separately from missing values (decision 2026-08-21).
# Serum albumin is specified in canonical g/dl (see its note).
# The test battery compares CLINICAL_RANGE_REGISTRY against this file value by value.
